lifecycle_cross_review.reviewer: evidence agent, independent of runtime implementation
lifecycle_cross_review.finding: Interrupted or prematurely exiting audit launchers could leave descendant verification processes running after the capture lock was released.
lifecycle_cross_review.fix: Each command owns a new process group; interrupt deferral covers only launch assignment; SIGINT/TERM/KILL escalation completes before the failed record is published and the lock closes. Original signal handlers are restored.
lifecycle_cross_review.validation: Runtime owner reports 49 focused tests passing with 100% line/branch coverage, including real SIGINT/SIGTERM launcher-grandchild cleanup and unrelated-process preservation. Evidence reviewer independently read the final runner end-to-end and found no additional concrete defect.
lifecycle_cross_review.limit: Final all-service acceptance is recorded by the root fresh verifier, not inferred from focused test counts.

darwin_permission_cross_review.finding: Darwin can return EPERM for a zombie-only process group between poll/reap and group probing/signaling. Prior handling raised immediately, failing a completed verification cleanup.
darwin_permission_cross_review.fix_review: Probe PermissionError conservatively means the group still exists. Signal PermissionError triggers bounded polling/reaping, and succeeds only after ProcessLookupError proves disappearance. Persistent permission denial re-raises after the bounded wait; it never silently declares cleanup complete.
darwin_permission_cross_review.reviewer: Evidence reviewer independently read both new exception handlers, their surrounding process-group lifecycle and all three new regressions; no additional concrete defect established.

focused_tests.warning: One existing runpy module-import RuntimeWarning; no test failure.

darwin_permission_cross_review.fail_before: All three new tests failed against prior SHA-256 9282d63d33b3a8cadc352d8abed63aeab7e85508a4a3d9344f1790335e4c2b20 in isolated replay: transient disappearance, bounded persistent denial and actual Darwin zombie group.
darwin_permission_cross_review.actual_os_probe: Runtime preserved a probe of 1,500 owned child exits with transient PermissionError observations; reviewer inspected the recorded result. Actual deterministic zombie regression proves subsequent reaping and confirmed disappearance.

primary_source.interpretation: killpg1 group iteration filters SZOMB; a group with no eligible found processes returns EPERM for POSIX behavior. This explains the observed macOS zombie-only result.

darwin_permission_cross_review.limit: Focused evidence is not substituted for the root new frozen full audit.
